title: The dense molecular gas in the z ∼ 6 QSO SDSS J231038.88+185519.7 resolved by ALMA
question: Resolve the dense molecular gas (CO(6-5)) and 3.3 mm continuum in the z~6 QSO J2310+1855 host to derive gas, dynamical and BH masses and compare CO(6-5) with [CII].

data.bands: Band 3 (CO(6-5), continuum); [CII] data separately; band 6 data also scanned
data.angular_resolution: Band 3 natural: 0.6x0.4 arcsec PA=-6 deg; Briggs: 0.51x0.28 arcsec; [CII]: 0.9x0.6 arcsec PA=49 deg
data.sensitivity: Continuum 5.4 μJy/beam; 0.13 mJy/beam per 23.7 km/s channel; [CII] 0.20 mJy/beam per 100 km/s

evidence.quote: derived from $\rm L_{FIR}$ (from W13) and the Kennicutt & Evans (2012) relation.
